observable_work_alignment.rule: Every traced operation projects through ObservableWork. Demo op events now carry progressKind (determinate|indeterminate), source (measured|derived|unknown), completed/total only when a real denominator exists, and waitReason from the waiting_* vocabulary. Determinate display without a real denominator is banned (also section 16.6). Production wiring should map trace phases onto the register's generic state grammar (accepted, queued, starting, running, waiting_provider, waiting_resource, waiting_for_idle, retrying, committing, verifying, rolling_back, completed, failed, cancelled, recovery_required among others).
demo_changes: index-rebuild: indeterminate scanning phase, then measured completed/total file counts; c4 renders counts and real-valued progressbar aria, never a bare percentage
dest-test rate-limited phase carries waitReason waiting_resource
credits meter aria exposes real units (used of total) instead of a percentage
